vendor_compilers: Apple Clang and zig cc require their own version/content lock plus feature probe; do not equate vendor version numbers to upstream Clang
sanitizer_profile_rules: Compile separately. Replace, do not append, optimization setting. Never combine address and thread. Validate native toolchain/libc support. Missing support is unsupported/not_run, not passed.

target_rules.linux_sanitizers: separately pinned, known-supported dynamic libc profile; auxiliary artifacts are not release binaries
target_rules.macos: SDK + deployment target + arch must be locked

lock_requirement: Fill from verified downloaded artifacts in P0; null forbids claims of a reproducible release build
